message.content: {"note_claim": "Under the TPS statute, the Supreme Court ruled that the administration has the authority to end TPS.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Justice Samuel Alito said that the TPS statute bars any court review of how the president and his Department of Homeland Security have used their authority to end TPS status.", "reason": "The NPR article reports the Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling that, under the TPS law, the president has unreviewable authority to end TPS, which directly substantiates the note's second claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Under the TPS statute, the Supreme Court ruled that the administration has the authority to end TPS.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Justice Samuel Alito said that the TPS statute bars any court review of how the president and his Department of Homeland Security have used their authority to end TPS status.
parsed.reason: The NPR article reports the Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling that, under the TPS law, the president has unreviewable authority to end TPS, which directly substantiates the note's second claim.
